newsitem.title: THAILAND: TPI Polene to issue 260.7 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: TPI Polene to issue 260.7 mln new shares.

text.p: Thai cement producer TPI Polene Plc said on Monday it will issue 260.7 million new shares to raise registered capital to 5.31 billion baht ($204.2 million) from 2.7 billion.
Of the new shares, 253.75 million shares will be offered to existing shareholders through a one-for-one rights issue at 10 baht each, TPI Polene said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
The remaining shares will be reserved for the conversion of the company's existing convertible debentures, it said.
TPI Polene did not say what it would do with the funds from the share issue.
